import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
evidence=root.parent/'checks/parametric/evidence'
manifest=json.loads((evidence/'manifest.json').read_text())
for relative,expected in manifest['files_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((evidence/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,relative
for relative,expected in manifest['source_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,relative
settings=[]
for row in manifest['episodes']:
    name=row['file']
    public=json.loads((evidence/'public'/name).read_text())
    private=json.loads((evidence/'authoring'/name).read_text())
    assert set(public)=={'train','test'}
    assert len(public['train'])==3 and len(public['test'])==2
    assert all(set(pair)=={'input','output'} for pair in public['train'])
    assert all(set(pair)=={'input'} for pair in public['test'])
    assert public['train']==private['episode']['train']
    assert [pair['input'] for pair in public['test']]==[pair['input'] for pair in private['episode']['test']]
    checks=private['parameter_rival_checks']
    chosen=private['episode']['parameters']['rank_order']
    assert checks['compatible_settings']==[chosen]
    settings.append(chosen)
assert set(settings)=={'ascending','descending'}
receipts=json.loads((evidence/'authoring/bridge-receipts.json').read_text())
assert len(receipts)==manifest['bridge_evaluations']==98
for row in receipts:
    assert row['error'] is None
    for key in ('input','output'):
        digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(row[key],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
        assert digest==row[key+'_sha256']
summary={'status':'passed','checked_files':len(manifest['files_sha256']),'checked_sources':len(manifest['source_sha256']),'public_challenges':len(settings),'public_query_inputs':2*len(settings),'bridge_receipts':len(receipts),'settings_counts':{setting:settings.count(setting) for setting in sorted(set(settings))},'program_hashes':{row['rank_order']:row['program_text_sha256'] for row in manifest['programs']},'source_sha256':manifest['source_sha256']}
(root.parent/'checks/parametric/artifact-integrity.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True))
